verdict.rationale: Lithic is API-first. Its docs show broad programmatic coverage: card creation, auth rules at program, account and card levels, webhook registration and replay, disputes, account holders and sandbox simulation. None of the evidence states that the API matches the dashboard UI feature-for-feature, so parity is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or matrix showing API-to-UI parity, a public OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404 on all candidate paths), and independent hands-on corroboration that no feature is UI-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
